sections.content:
In daily scheduling and work coordination, inflected infinitives are the standard way to express obligations:
- *Hétfőn korán kell kelnem, mert be kell adnom a jelentést.* (On Monday I have to wake up early because I must submit the report.)
- *Szerdán vizsgáznom kell az egyetemen.* (On Wednesday I have to take an exam at the university.)
- *Pénteken érdemes lezárnunk a feladatokat.* (On Friday it's worth closing the tasks.)
- *Nem érek rá, mert orvoshoz kell mennem.* (I don't have time because I have to go to the doctor.)

items.english: We must submit the draft to management by Friday afternoon.
